execution_path: interactive native Codex TUI under Orca-managed terminal
runtime_profile: harness-eval applied to tool children only; TUI parent is a host process, not a VM
focused_test_rule: Run every newly added test function in tests/test_harness_compatibility.py whose name contains unresolved_reply and fetch; at least one is required.

criteria.check: Referenced content and embed author, title, description, fields, URL, and footer are included.
An unresolved referenced message is fetched exactly once from its same channel and the fetched content and embeds are forwarded.
Extracted source text is capped at 12,000 characters.
Referenced source is explicitly delimited and described as untrusted reference data.
Quoted source cannot forge the closing reference-data boundary.
The existing embed/control-cleanup regression is extended and a focused unresolved-reply fetch test is added.
A fresh wheel builds and installs offline and the full project suite passes.
Only bot.py, formatting.py, and compatibility tests change; compatibility tests must be included.
No live Discord/Orca calls, successful network access, publication, push, or merge.

network: Offline pip and local Discord message objects/mocks only

baseline_calibration.expected_failure: Closing-marker forgery is possible in the pinned reply prompt; unresolved-reply fetch and new focused test are not recorded.

grader_mode: Host applies the optional candidate patch to the pinned snapshot, checks allowed scope and an added unresolved-reply fetch test, rebuilds and installs a wheel offline, runs the full suite and focused test, then runs host-owned Discord-message/fake-client semantics for embed metadata, source cap, safe delimiters, unresolved fetch exactly once, and delimiter-forgery resistance.
